help.title: TuiEdit — a simple TUI text editor (MS Edit / nano style).
help.k1: F2 or ^S save (asks for name if new)   ^O save as   ^Q quit
help.k2: ^F find       F3 next / Shift+F3 prev   ^H replace   ^G go to line
help.k3: ^K cut line  ^U/^V paste  ^C copy line  ^D duplicate
help.k4: ^C also puts the copy into the system clipboard (Windows Terminal) — paste with Ctrl+V
help.k5: ^Z undo  ^Y redo  ^A select all   Shift+arrows — selection
help.k6: arrows/Home/End/PgUp/PgDn, Ctrl+arrows — by word, Alt+up/down — move line
help.k7: Enter — new line, Tab — indent, Shift+Tab — unindent
help.k8: Terminal clipboard paste — as full text in a single undo step
help.k9: F10 or Alt+F/E/H — menu (arrows/Enter/Esc, letter hotkey)
help.k10: Open/Save as — file manager (arrows • Enter • Bksp up • Esc)
help.status: Status bar: position | encoding | line endings | indent | file.
help.note1: Note: classic Windows console may intercept ^S
help.note2: as output pause (XOFF) — press F2 then.
